summary: Iteration 23 (Clarity Release) — full backend + frontend validation. ALL critical paths pass. Backend: 53/53 existing tests green (10 iter23 + 43 regression across iter11/14/17/21) PLUS 5 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration23_extra.py covering (a) LemonSqueezy webhook with valid HMAC granting season_30days pass with consumed=true and expires_at ~30d, (b) the-night-angels-embrace download returning 404 even with a purchase row (CDN intentionally broken — confirmed by founder), (c) the other 3 kids PDFs (engels-friends-2, angels-tales, angels-story) downloading 200 OK after manual purchase grant. Total backend: 58/58 PASS. Frontend (synthetic Mongo session): /clarity-release renders page-clarity-release + clarity-gate signed-out; nav-clarity-release present; /private-room redirects to /clarity-release (Navigate replace); 'Quiet Room' string absent on /, /clarity-release, /portal, /the-beginning; footer Explore column has 'Clarity Release'. Signed-in hub renders clarity-beta-notice + 3 purpose blocks (listen/clarify/release) + 3 tier cards (30min/60min/season_30days) showing $15/$30/$70 and disabled 'Opens this Friday' buy buttons. clarity-hub-continue → clarity-confirm → 3 checkboxes enable clarity-confirm-continue → clarity-chat. Encryption badge text confirmed: 'Encrypted at rest · AES-256'. clarity-release-ritual present. Round-trip message send renders the user bubble with the sent text. No console errors, no page errors.

(Optional) Add per-element data-testid to TierCard price spans (e.g. clarity-tier-30min-price) so FE tests can assert on '$15' textContent without depending on visual screenshot. Today the price renders across multiple styled spans which makes literal-string assertions brittle.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/clarity_crypto.py — clean AES-256-GCM impl with random nonce per encryption, base64 wire format, tamper detection via GCM auth tag. is_configured() correctly gates startup. Good separation from server.py.

server.py — CabinetMessage.text_enc is the persisted column and CabinetMessage.text is empty at write time. _get_active_cabinet_session decrypts text_enc back into text on read for /cabinet/me — round-trip is correct, no plaintext leaks into the Mongo document (verified by direct Mongo inspection).

server.py — /clarity/start correctly rebinds the placeholder expires_at on the granted ClarityPass to now+30min/60min/30d AND marks consumed=true atomically. Subsequent /cabinet/message calls observe has_active_pass=true via the session's tier+expires_at and skip the 3-reply soft gate as required. show_continuation never fires for paid users — verified across 4 sequential user messages.

server.py — dispute-unlock endpoint correctly enforces role=='admin' (403 otherwise), decrypts messages into the response, AND writes the audit row in db.clarity_dispute_unlocks with admin_user_id + reason + session_id + timestamp. /admin/unlock-log mirrors the role gate. Good.

server.py — LemonSqueezy webhook now branches on custom_data.pass_tier vs custom_data.book_slug. HMAC SHA-256 verification using LEMONSQUEEZY_WEBHOOK_SECRET stays in place. order_refunded path for passes was not exercised in tests (only order_created was) — recommend the founder confirm refund/revoke semantics for ClarityPass before going live.

ClarityRelease.jsx — well-decomposed into SoftGate / HubPanel / TierCard / ConfirmPanel / ChatPanel / FloatingBagRitual. data-testid coverage is excellent. Buy buttons stay disabled with 'Opens this Friday' — by design until variant IDs land. Encryption badge string matches the exact spec ('Encrypted at rest · AES-256').

App.js — /private-room → /clarity-release uses React Router <Navigate replace> which is correct (drops the old route from history rather than stacking). Verified — final URL is /clarity-release after visiting /private-room.

test_iteration23.py — uses a synthetic-Mongo session pattern consistent with iter14/iter17. Cleans up users/sessions/cabinet_sessions/clarity_passes per fixture teardown. Audit row cleanup at the end of test_dispute_unlock_admin_only keeps clarity_dispute_unlocks tidy across runs. Good hygiene.

MINOR: clarity_passes does not have a unique compound index on (user_id, tier, consumed=false). If two webhook events for the same order fire (idempotency edge), a user could end up with two pending passes of the same tier. Recommend either a unique partial index or upsert in the webhook handler keyed on external_order_id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 (Clarity Release) is GREEN end-to-end.
